The shop

NO FRILLS.
JUST GOOD CUTS.

Classic barber chairs, wood floors and a wall of Newport history.

Hair Apparent is a veteran-owned barbershop run by Tony Moore and David Lockhart. Come in for a cut, stay for the conversation, and catch the game while you wait.

Look around

INSIDE

Good to know

QUESTIONS

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes. Booking ahead just saves you the wait.

Is there a military discount?

Yes. Military, seniors and students get a lower price. Just let your barber know.

What are the hours?

Our hours sign is a local legend. We're usually here, but call (401) 380-6746 to be sure.

Where do I park?

Lower Thames has street parking and nearby lots. Look for the barber pole and the brick steps at 424.
